$comment: Per-file budgets for unbundled public assets. Baseline 2026-09-30 (raw/gzip bytes): events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Ceilings leave roughly 25-45% headroom, not room for a framework import. Islands added later start at measured size plus 25-33% headroom: copy-link (ceilings 3072/1280), avatar 610 raw (1024/512), admin-event-editor 979/482 (1280/640 at first, see TOG-12992 below), admin-event-text-limits 1594/725 (2048/1024), auth-status 4152/1576 (5120/2048) and rsvp-button 28628/7371 (35840/9728, added on main by #98). Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. CEO decision 2026-10-03 on TOG-10845 approved raising the five 2026-09-30 ceilings to measured size x1.25 (rounded up): events-calendar.js 12356/3975 -> 15872/5120, going-count.js 6800/2548 -> 8704/3328, member-profile.js 15547/4969 -> 19456/6400, past-events.js 6275/2024 -> 8192/2560, public/styles.css 5678/1841 -> 7168/2304 (measured on the merged tree, main 0bc7b0cb). Growth drivers are main's theme/port work since the baseline, not this PR; this PR adds gates only and does not rewrite or minify served CSS or JavaScript. CEO decision 2026-10-03 on TOG-12992 approved raising public/islands/admin-event-editor.js 1280/640 -> 3584/1536 (measured 2843/1189 x1.25, rounded up 512/256). Growth driver is main #344 (033059bf, admin session-expiry draft-hold in the editor islands), 1013/485 -> 2843/1189, not this PR; the raise covers that one island only and a further increase needs a new decision. A separate CEO decision 2026-10-03 on TOG-12992 raised public/islands/admin-event-editor.js 1280/640 -> 3584/1536 (measured 2843/1189 x1.25, rounded up, on the merged tree, main d0df0afc); the growth driver is main #344 (033059bf, admin session-expiry draft-hold in the editor islands, 1013/485 before it), not this PR, and the decision raises that one island only: a further increase needs a new decision. A build-time minification follow-up will let these ceilings come back down later.
